console-charcoal.purpose: The room's fixed ground; never repaints. Also paints the browser chrome via the committed theme-color.

bezel-plate.purpose: Raised panels one step above ground: boards, instrument beds, nameplate, caution panels, the favicon's bezel.

recessed-well.purpose: Inset beds: flap digit wells, the SIGNAL LOST bed, the archive full-draft well, the favicon's digit well.

luminous-bone.purpose: The readout color: primary text, lit board digits, the primary plate fill; selection inverts bone-on-ground.

bone-dim.purpose: Secondary text (labels, status, meta, excerpts, plate text). >=4.5:1 on ground.

bone-faint.purpose: Annotations and disabled affordances ONLY (~3:1) — never body text.

phosphor-green.purpose: LIVE / SAFE / nominal lamp; the one sanctioned non-lamp green is keyboard focus.

caution-amber.purpose: The FADE / hold lamp and the whole caution band — warning before loss, never terminal.

destruct-red.purpose: LOSS lamp, SIGNAL LOST readout, CONFIRM CLEAR / armed CONFIRM DELETE. Terminal, once, never decorative.

green-unlit.purpose: The LIVE lamp off — dark tinted glass, still present.

hairline.purpose: Bezel lines over any surface; 1px line weight (--hairline).

display.purpose: The presiding T-MM:SS countdown (and the setup console's duration board on the same classes), top-center. B612 Mono 700, tabular; minute-slot count fixed (zero layout shift).

instrument.purpose: DSEG14 Classic, this board only, display size capped to hold one line from phones up. B612 Mono fallback.

title.purpose: Screen verdicts and binder identity (DOWN SAFE - THREAT DISARMED, FLIGHT LOG). 13px Michroma caps.

label.purpose: Status line (FADING - type to restore), confirm titles, verdicts, the setup validation line. 11px Michroma caps.

label-sm.purpose: Lamp names, stat labels, column strips, plate controls, notes/counts, placard limits. 10px Michroma caps.

numeric.purpose: Every live number that is not the board: stat values, countdown numerals, the custom-minutes well. 14px B612 Mono tabular.

numeric-lg.purpose: Run times flush right (log spine, RUN stat, entry rows), the reduced-motion deletion countdown, and the placard duration values. 19px.

body.purpose: Prose outside the editor: excerpts, outcome copy, notes, the setup intro. Countdown Room Prose 18px/1.65.

body-editor.purpose: The draft itself in the textarea: 19px/1.65 dark-ground size, 70ch measure. Weight 400 regular, 600 strong (log titles).

shadows.name: panel-edge
shadows.purpose: The one sanctioned box-shadow: a zero-blur 1px inset bezel hairline on raised plates and wells, where a border would double the line.

shadows.name: lamp-glow
shadows.purpose: A lit lamp dome's halo. Capability layer: no-preference motion only, absent under reduce.

shadows.name: board-halo
shadows.purpose: Luminous board figures in a dim room. No-preference motion only.

shadows.name: readout-halo
shadows.purpose: The SIGNAL LOST red halo. No-preference motion only.

motion.name: ease-damped
motion.purpose: State changes, boards, reveals, the cover lift. The room's default easing: exponential ease-out from an already-visible default.

motion.name: dur-flap
motion.purpose: One split-flap digit turning (transform-only, compositor-side). JS twin: FLIP_SETTLE_MS = 300.

motion.name: dur-board
motion.purpose: Whole-board settling: the wind-down tape flip and the archive well/grid reveals.

motion.name: dur-state
motion.purpose: Lamp and state indications (plate color/bezel, status, band).

motion.name: dur-arm
motion.purpose: The one guarded arm gesture: the MASTER ARM cover's hinge lift on the setup console — the gesture the token was minted for, spent on the cover's transform. Collapses to 0.01ms under reduced motion; the state change itself stays.

motion.name: loss-latch
motion.purpose: The LOSS annunciator latching a fault: three hard on/off switches then steady lit. Lamps switch, never fade. No-preference motion only.

motion.name: reduced-motion-collapse
motion.purpose: Capability switch: durations collapse so transitioned surfaces hold still; --motion-level is the committed JS seam (getComputedStyle). The threat fade is deliberately UNTOKENIZED - opacity is computed per frame from wall-clock by the engine and applied directly, full-motion only.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: The only breakpoint: the console stacks by criticality (board, lamps, column); the archive collapses to spine-style rows; placards tighten and wrap; board scale is viewport-clamped everywhere else.

components.name: Plate (control)
components.description: Every action on every phase — defined once in the shared plates.css layer imported before any screen sheet: transparent ground, hairline bezel, placard caps; brightens on hover, presses 1px on active. Transient COPY states wear lamp colors (COPIED green / COPY FAILED amber, 2.4s).
components.css: .ds-plate { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--bone-dim); font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-plate:hover { color: var(--bone); border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-plate:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-color); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-plate:disabled { color: var(--bone-faint); border-color: var(--line); cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Primary Plate
components.description: The room's one energized control (ARM, RE-ARM, DONE, NEW SESSION): bone fill on charcoal, flush right where the run time lives. RE-ARM prints the recalled calibration on its face (one-motion restart; a min() scoped to the deleted board caps its 27-char worst case at the 320px floor); DONE holds KEYBOARD activation for one beat after disarm while pointer clicks always pass.
components.css: .ds-plate-primary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--bone); background: var(--bone); color: var(--ground); font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-plate-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bone) 88%, var(--ground)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bone) 88%, var(--ground)); } .ds-plate-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-plate-primary:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destruct Plate
components.description: The control that destructs: CONFIRM CLEAR (multi-entry clear-all) and the armed second step CONFIRM DELETE of the two-step single-entry delete. Destruct red reserved for the control that destructs.
components.css: .ds-plate-destruct { appearance: none; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--lamp-red) 45%, transparent); background: transparent; color: var(--lamp-red); font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-plate-destruct:hover { color: var(--lamp-red); border-color: var(--lamp-red); } .ds-plate-destruct:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Range-Safety Lamps
components.description: Annunciator pair: a lit dome plus an unlit dome under engraved Michroma legends. Unlit lamps stay present as dark tinted glass; the lit dome glows under no-preference motion only.
components.html: LIVEFADE
components.css: .ds-lamps { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; } .ds-lamp { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-lamp-dome { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-lamp-live { background: var(--lamp-green); } .ds-lamp-fade-off { background: var(--lamp-amber-dim); } .ds-lamp-name { font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bone-dim); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-lamp-live { box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--lamp-green) 50%, transparent); } }

components.name: Flap Board (static wells)
components.description: The presiding countdown: raised bezel plate, recessed 1ch x 1em digit wells with the hinge seam across each middle, T- prefix engraved alongside. Live digits flip transform-only (300ms, ease-flap); this static rendering is also the reduced-motion and no-preserve-3d path. The setup console's duration board is the same instrument on the same classes.
components.html: T–0055:0000
components.css: .ds-flap-board { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font-family: var(--font-numeric); font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--bone); background: var(--panel-raised); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; line-height: 1; } .ds-flap-prefix { font-size: 0.32em; font-weight: 400; color: var(--bone-dim); margin-right: 4px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-flap-colon { line-height: 1; } .ds-flap-slot { position: relative; width: 1ch; height: 1em; background: var(--panel-inset); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-flap-slot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; margin-top: -0.5px; background: var(--ground); } .ds-flap-half { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 0; height: 50%; overflow: hidden; } .ds-flap-half-bottom { top: auto; bottom: 0; } .ds-flap-glyph { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 200%; line-height: 1; text-align: center; display: block; } .ds-flap-half-bottom .ds-flap-glyph { top: auto; bottom: 0; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-flap-board { text-shadow: 0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--bone) 18%, transparent); } }

components.name: SIGNAL LOST Readout
components.description: The destruct annunciator's instrument face: DSEG14 Classic on a recessed bed with an inset lip, red at display size (capped to hold one line from phones up). The reserved instrument face - this board alone, never the flap board. Flanked by RE-ARM (carrying the recalled calibration) and RECONFIGURE.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-instrument); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--lamp-red); background: var(--panel-inset); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 12px 16px 16px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-readout { text-shadow: 0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--lamp-red) 26%, transparent); } }

components.name: Flight-Log Row
components.description: The archive's unit: a hairline-ruled row on the ground itself (a log sheet, not cards) with the run time flush right in tabular numerals - the log's spine. Row DELETE is a two-step plate: the first press arms CONFIRM DELETE in the destruct red (caution spoken through the polite region), the second press performs; Escape or a 5s lapse reverts to DELETE, one confirm live at a time.
components.html:
Untitled session

5:00

2026-08-28 21:04Z · STANDARD · 412 words

Keep typing. The clock does not wait.
components.css: .ds-log-entry { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-log-entry:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bone) 4%, transparent); } .ds-entry-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px 16px; } .ds-entry-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-prose); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--bone); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-entry-run { margin: 0; justify-self: end; font-family: var(--font-numeric); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--bone); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-entry-meta { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-numeric); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--bone-dim); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-entry-excerpt { margin: 0; max-width: 70ch; font-family: var(--font-prose); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--bone-dim); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Caution Panel
components.description: The one raised hold/decision panel, reserved for the multi-entry clear decision (and the reduced-motion caution placard): amber hairline down the leading edge while the field stays achromatic, amber placard title, bone-dim body. The single row's caution is spoken, not painted.
components.html:
CLEAR THE FLIGHT LOG?

Every survived session in this browser will be deleted. There is no recovery.
components.css: .ds-caution { display: grid; gap: 12px; justify-items: start; background: var(--panel-raised); border-left: 1px solid var(--lamp-amber); border-radius: 2px; padding: 16px; max-width: 70ch; } .ds-caution-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--lamp-amber); } .ds-caution-body { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-prose); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--bone-dim); }

components.name: Setup Placard (switch plate)
components.description: The setup console's radio placards (duration presets, CUSTOM, GENTLE/STANDARD/BRUTAL with printed FADE/LOSS limits): a raised switch plate whose native radio covers it as an invisible hit target. Selected = pressed in: the plate sinks to its recessed bed and the reading lights to full bone; focus shows on the placard as the 2px focus-green band (--focus-width). Achromatic by commitment - selection is lightness and inversion, never a lamp hue.
components.css: .ds-placard { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 5.5rem; background: var(--panel-raised); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 12px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-placard-radio { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: 0; appearance: none; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-placard-face { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-placard-name { font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bone-dim); transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-placard-limits { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-placard-limits span { font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bone-dim); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-placard:has(.ds-placard-radio:checked) { background: var(--panel-inset); } .ds-placard:has(.ds-placard-radio:checked) .ds-placard-name { color: var(--bone); } .ds-placard:has(.ds-placard-radio:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Guarded ARM Station (MASTER ARM)
components.description: The room's one primary action, low and isolated at the bottom of the setup console's remaining space: the energized ARM plate under a physical cover. One deliberate motion, two physical steps - LIFT COVER (hinges at its top edge, vanishing past edge-on over the committed --dur-arm gesture token, 260ms damped), then ARM. While closed the cover owns the tab order; Escape re-covers and returns focus to the cover; the router's deliberate focus on ARM - arriving via the deleted board's RECONFIGURE or the archive's NEW SESSION - lifts the cover by itself.
components.html:
MASTER ARM

NO PAUSE - NO RECOVERY
components.css: .ds-setup-arm { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--panel-raised); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 24px 20px; perspective: 900px; } .ds-setup-arm-legend, .ds-setup-arm-note { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bone-dim); } .ds-arm-socket { position: relative; display: grid; } .ds-setup-arm-trigger { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--bone); background: var(--bone); color: var(--ground); font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; padding: 12px 28px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-arm-cover { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--panel-inset); color: var(--bone-dim); font-family: var(--font-placard); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transform-origin: 50% 0%; backface-visibility: hidden; transition: transform var(--dur-arm) var(--ease-damped), visibility 0s linear 0s; } .ds-setup-arm[data-open] .ds-arm-cover { transform: rotateX(-100deg); visibility: hidden; transition: transform var(--dur-arm) var(--ease-damped), visibility 0s linear var(--dur-arm); }

narrative.overview:
One console through five mission phases — setup, write, deleted, wind-down, archive — where the split-flap clock presides and the draft is telemetry that dies when the signal is lost. Every screen is the same console at a different mission phase, not a separate page. The world is analog-physical and damped: engraved placard caps, tabular avionics numerals, recessed wells, hairline bezels, panel grain. Roughly 90% of any surface is achromatic — charcoal ground, bone readouts — and the only hue in the room is the range-safety lamp triad, locked to state semantics. Depth comes from hairlines and overlap; soft shadows do not exist anywhere in the system.

The room refuses two things by commitment: the serene writing-app canvas with its reassuring toolbar (the direction contract's explicit refusal), and the glassy dashboard / neon terminal reading of mission control. Pressure is carried by real instruments, not by drama: text pales under an amber hairline band while a flap board ticks; the destruct annunciator latches hard; re-arm is one motion straight into the next session on the last-used calibration. Motion is damped and mechanical (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) family), gated as a capability layer — under prefers-reduced-motion the room swaps instruments (static amber placard + numeric countdown) rather than going dark, and lamp colors keep switching because they are state, not motion.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed console-charcoal ground that never repaints; threat rides as overlays on top of it
Bone luminous readouts on ~90% achromatic surfaces; three locked lamp hues only

Michroma engraved placard caps; B612 Mono tabular numerals for every live number; Countdown Room Prose (Source Sans 3, OFL-renamed) for all long-form text; DSEG14 Classic reserved for the SIGNAL LOST board alone
Hairline (1px) bezel discipline, zero-blur inset panel edges, no soft shadows
Machined corners (2px plates, 4px large plates); lamp domes are the only full rounds
Split-flap countdown board presides top-center; per-digit fixed wells give zero layout shift
Damped mechanical motion as a capability layer; hard lamp switching in both motion modes
Fixed low-opacity grain overlay kills flat-black banding and survives reduced motion

rules.name: The Locked Lamp Rule
rules.body: Green = nominal/alive, amber = fading/hold, red = destruct/signal lost. Lamps mean state and never decorate; no hue exists outside these roles (focus green is the one sanctioned extension). Rarity is the point — amber and red each appear on a screen only while their state is true.

rules.name: The Fixed Ground Rule
rules.body: The charcoal ground never repaints. Threat, caution, and texture ride as overlays and edge bands; a screen never paints a full-bleed replacement background.

rules.name: The Unlit Lamp Rule
rules.body: An unlit lamp is not removed — it stays on the console as dark tinted glass. State absent is itself information.

rules.name: The Three Instruments Rule
rules.body: Placard caps for labels, avionics numerals for numbers, prose for long-form text — and never crosswise. Placard text is tracked uppercase and short (≤ ~24 chars); long-form text exists only in the prose face.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every live number is set tabular (`tnum`, slashed-zero off). Numbers must never shift the layout while counting — B612 Mono's digits are equal-advance by construction and the flap wells are fixed 1ch × 1em regardless.

rules.name: The Reserved Instrument Rule
rules.body: DSEG14 Classic renders the SIGNAL LOST readout and nothing else — never the animated flap board, never labels. Segment-LCD and split-flap are different instruments; mixing them breaks the metaphor. (In reduced motion the numeric inactivity countdown is B612 Mono, not DSEG14 — the reservation holds in both motion modes.)

rules.name: The No-Soft-Shadows Rule
rules.body: No blurred drop shadows exist in this system and none may be added. Depth = lightness step + hairline edge + overlap; glow is a motion-gated halo on lit instruments, never elevation.

dos: Do keep ~90% of every surface achromatic; hue appears only as lamp state, the caution band, focus green, or the reserved red of destruction.
Do set every live number in B612 Mono with tabular figures, in a fixed-width context when it counts (flap wells are 1ch × 1em) — zero layout shift while counting is an invariant.
Do hold prose to the measure (70ch) at 18–19px / 1.65 leading on the dark ground.
Do keep the leading-edge band at a constant width across transparent → green → amber — the committed `--focus-width` (2px) token that every focus ring also draws — so the prose measure never moves.
Do switch lamps hard (180ms damped, or `steps(1, end)` in authored latches); keep unlit lamps visible as tinted glass.

Do gate flap rotation, board flip, lamp latch, glows, and halos behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` (flaps additionally behind `preserve-3d`); under reduce, swap instruments — static per-digit swap, static amber placard + B612 numeric countdown — while lamp colors keep switching.
Do let the engine apply the threat fade's opacity per frame from wall-clock output; never leave a CSS opacity transition running unwatched.
Do align run times and session stats flush against the right margin in tabular numerals — the log's spine.
donts: Don't add blurred or soft drop shadows, gradient surfaces, or glassy overlays; the panel edge is the only sanctioned box-shadow and it is a zero-blur hairline.
Don't repaint the ground, introduce a new background hue, or use DSEG14 anywhere except the SIGNAL LOST readout.
Don't use lamp hues decoratively (buttons, accents, illustrations) or introduce any hue beyond the locked triad + focus green.
Don't use bone-faint for readable text (annotations and disabled states only); quiet-but-readable is bone-dim.
Don't round corners beyond the machined 2px/4px steps — full rounds are lamp domes, exclusively.
Don't animate opacity as a state transition, fade a lamp's meaning, or add live stats to the write phase (numbers beyond the countdown exist only post-session).
Don't set long-form text in Michroma or DSEG14, or lowercase placard labels; don't exceed ~24 characters on a placard.
